name: Normal day
expected: Feasible plan or explicit infeasibility; enforce stock, supplier and cash constraints

name: Biscuit demand spike
trigger: Increase biscuit demand by 60 percent for two simulated days
expected: Recompute stock and orders; show unmet demand and replan

name: Supplier delay
trigger: Delay one supplier by two days; balance date unknown
expected: Compare alternatives; do not invent a revised date

name: Liquidity stress
trigger: Delay a ₹30,000.00 retailer payment by seven days
expected: Protect the ₹50,000.00 minimum buffer or report infeasible

name: Inventory discrepancy
trigger: Physical count finds 15 fewer base units for one SKU

name: Retailer complaint
trigger: Late delivery complaint with product mention but no order ID
expected: Preserve exact evidence and request clarification for unmatched order

name: Competitor report
expected: Show as reported/unverified, not as established market fact

name: Combined disruption
trigger: Demand increase, supplier delay and delayed payment together
expected: Replan under hard constraints or explain infeasibility

name: Overdue retailer with new order
trigger: Retailer with an overdue receivable places a new order
expected: Show exposure and hold for human credit review; no credit decision

name: Scheme claim mismatch
trigger: Retailer claims a promotion that does not match the approved scheme register
expected: Compare claim with scheme terms; no discount or credit note executed

name: Short and damaged delivery
trigger: Received quantity, damage and wrong-item count differ from the purchase order
expected: Show delivery variance and raise a supplier claim for human approval

name: Batch recall and quality hold
trigger: Supplier issues a quality hold for one batch
expected: Quarantine affected batch and block allocation; human approval only

name: Short-dated stock and return window
trigger: Batch expires inside the supplier return window
expected: Recommend return or priority dispatch; no stock mutation

name: Dispatch under vehicle capacity
expected: Allocate by priority and promised date; list deferred orders
